parts:
Finally found the culprit: after upgrading R and the extrafont package, I needed to re-run 
font_import()
That fixed the issue.

What made this challenging is that it only cause problems with some graphics devices with Arial specified: only some of the grid package and pdf.
png and cairoPpdf were ok.
